name: poll_replies
description: Scan Gmail for new inbound replies in any thread we've sent outreach on. For each new reply: persist as an inbound message row, advance the candidate's stage (intro_sent → replied), cancel pending follow-up tasks (they replied — no need to nag), and classify the reply intent so the operator knows what to do next. Runs from a 2-min schedule. Idempotent: re-running won't double-record.
